name: Primo Packaging
old_description: As a trusted manufacturer and converter, Primo Packaging produces durable, customizable plastic bags designed to meet your exact specifications. From raw material to finished product, every step of our process is engineered for consistency, efficiency, and quality.
about:
Primo Packaging operates from Orlando, Florida, as a manufacturer and converter of custom plastic bags and flexible packaging. The company produces a wide range of bag styles, pouches, and films for diverse end markets.

The facility offers eight-color process printing and multiple lamination methods — solvent, extrusion, dry, and co-extrusion — to create multi-layer structures using materials such as polyethylene, polypropylene, BOPP, CPP, PET, PVDC, and nylon. Capabilities extend to producing three-side-seal pouches, stand-up pouches, flat-bottom pouches, quad-seal bags, wicketed bags, and a long list of standard bag styles including poly mailers, gusseted bags, pallet covers, drum liners, vacuum pouches, and zipper bags. Film formats range from layflat tubing and center-slit gusseted to various sheeting configurations.

Primo Packaging serves industries including confectionery, bakeries, snack foods, pet products, meat and fish processing, agriculture, and landscaping. Customers span food processors, consumer goods packagers, and industrial suppliers requiring custom-printed or plain barrier films.

The company emphasizes that every step from raw material to finished product is engineered for consistency, efficiency, and quality, positioning itself as a full-service partner that controls the entire converting process in-house.

name: Priority Plastics Inc
old_description: We invest in our people, equipment and technology to bring you the best packaging solutions available through quality, timeliness, relationships and sustainability.
about:
Priority Plastics, Inc. is headquartered in Grand Prairie, Texas, and operates extrusion blow-molding manufacturing facilities strategically located across the United States. The company provides plastic packaging solutions with a focus on quality, timeliness, relationships, and sustainability.

The company produces HDPE and PET containers, including PriorityPour tight-head containers, canisters, and dry-pack towel wipes, using extrusion blow molding and injection stretch blow molding (ISBM) processes. Its GreenLite program incorporates post-consumer recycled (PCR) content — up to 80% in ECO multi-layer products — and lightweighting designs. Priority Plastics offers in-plant customer service, custom and stock tooling, labeling capabilities, and multi-plant sourcing from its coast-to-coast footprint, serving customers from startups to multinational firms.

Priority Plastics serves food and beverage, nutrition and wellness, industrial, personal care, agriculture, animal health, cannabis/hemp/CBD, hardware, hazardous materials, healthcare/nutraceutical, and specialty chemicals markets.

The company states its people-centric culture and sustainability commitments drive its differentiation: facilities recycle unused resin, redesign packaging to reduce gram weight, and leverage geographic proximity to lower freight emissions. Published goals include sourcing 60% of materials from recycled or renewable sources by 2035, making 80% of products recyclable by 2028, and cutting Scope 2 and 3 emissions 30% by 2030.

name: Private Label Specialties
old_description: Uplevel Your Customer Experience & Profits With Branded Beverages.
about:
Private Label Specialties is based in Goffstown, New Hampshire, and was founded in 1991 by Ray Duhaime, who serves as president. The company began with a simple idea: offering custom-labeled sparkling water as an alternative to national brands, allowing businesses to put their own name on the bottle.

Today the company produces a line of old-fashioned beverages—including root beer, cream soda, spring water, lemonade, and eighteen other soda varieties—all custom-labeled for each client. It also operates an in-house apparel shop with screen printing, embroidery, and direct-to-garment printing, and sources over 750,000 customizable promotional products. Investments in technology have compressed the concept-to-finished-product cycle to under an hour for many orders.

The customer base spans restaurants, pizzerias, sub shops, catering companies, country stores, farm stands, and broader hospitality and service-based businesses. These clients use the branded beverages and apparel to create a memorable customer experience while generating additional revenue.

Duhaime started the business to give smaller establishments a way to market themselves without advertising for big brands. The company emphasizes a trifecta of competitive pricing, consistent quality, and responsive service—what it calls its Unique Branding Advantage—to help clients build loyalty and repeat business.

name: Pro-Forming Sheet Metal LLC
old_description: We offer our Metal Custom Fabrication customers superior supplemental Metal Machining and Milling
about:
Pro-Forming Sheet Metal LLC operates from a facility on Connecticut Avenue in Norwich, Connecticut. The company has been active in the metal fabrication industry for more than 25 years, building a reputation for handling custom orders from design through finished assembly. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a range of metalworking services including CNC turret punching, press brake forming, roll forming, sawing, plasma and oxy-acetylene cutting, as well as milling, drilling, and turning. Welding capabilities cover MIG, TIG, spot, brazing, and soldering on materials such as steel, stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, cast iron, and bronze. In-house finishing uses low-VOC wet paints, and the team handles mechanical assembly, sub-assembly, turnkey assembly, prototyping, and machinery rebuilding. Equipment includes a 30-ton 25-station Strippit/LVD CNC turret punch, a 10-foot 120-ton Strippit/LVD hydraulic press brake, a 6-foot 35-ton Chicago mechanical press brake, roll forming rolls, Kalamazoo saws, a 16-inch Doall vertical saw, L-Tec and Thermal Dynamics plasma cutters, and three MIG and two TIG welders.

Pro-Forming serves manufacturers in Connecticut and across the United States, offering a single-source solution that reduces the need for multiple vendors. The company emphasizes precision down to the thousandth of an inch and consistency across production runs, from prototypes to short, medium, and long runs.

The business was built on the idea of consolidating fabrication, machining, and finishing under one roof to control lead times and costs. Its craftsmen average over 20 years of industry experience, and the shop stores CNC programs for quick repeat orders.

name: ProStock Auto Parts - Saddle Brook
old_description: We’re a leading supplier to the Professional Installer of auto parts and equipment in New Jersey, New York and Connecticut.
about:
ProStock Automotive is headquartered in Saddle Brook, New Jersey, and operates a network of twelve locations across northern New Jersey and western Connecticut. The locally owned company has served the professional installer market for over 30 years, building a reputation for reliable parts supply across the tri-state area.

The distributor stocks a broad line of automotive parts for domestic, Asian, and European vehicles, carrying brands such as Denso, Bosch, Gates, Moog, and Delco. Its operations are supported by a fleet of company-owned, GPS-equipped vehicles managed through a centralized dispatch system, and a team of more than 25 counter specialists who average 20 years of experience each. Customers can order 24 hours a day through multiple online platforms, including ACDelco Connect, NexPart, and Parts Tech, while returns are processed and credited within 24 hours.

ProStock focuses exclusively on the professional installer—repair shops and technicians—in New Jersey, New York, and Connecticut. Its inventory and delivery infrastructure are tailored to the daily needs of those shops, providing same-day delivery on stocked items and technical support for hard-to-find parts.

The company’s stated mission is encapsulated in its name: “Professional service, always in stock.” It emphasizes a balance of scale and responsiveness, describing itself as large enough to offer competitive pricing and small enough to address individual customer needs, with a policy of never substituting price for quality.
